description: This file defines the VoiceOverlayTextFormatting enum with static helper functions for formatting and displaying text overlays, including delta calculation and attributed string construction with styling.

classes.name: VoiceOverlayTextFormatting
classes.description: An enum providing static methods for text formatting and attributed string creation for voice overlays.

methods.name: delta
methods.description: Calculates the remaining part of 'current' string after removing the prefix 'committed'.

methods.name: makeAttributed
methods.description: Creates an NSAttributedString with styled 'committed' and 'volatile' parts, adapting style based on whether the input is final.
